beats.text: Faith at home does not have to look formal.
No robes. No script. No perfect prayer.
Read about baptism? Baptise in the bath.
Read about prayer? Let them pray over you.
Children copy what you do, not what you say.
Which is uncomfortable. It is also the point.
But don't just listen to God's word. You must do what it says.
They are watching how you obey.
